The '''A-11 Model III "Burrower"''' was a tunnel boring vehicle manufactured by [[Corellia Mining Corporation/Legends|Corellia Mining Corporation]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] and was equipped with a [[TS-Titan]] [[Beamdrill/Legends|beamdrill]], produced by [[Karflo Corporation/Legends|Karflo Corporation]].
